developmental_shim: Local-only, never committed: linux/arm64 was added to toolchain/version/version.json supported_platforms, and version/protocol/boundary outputs were regenerated so `make toolchain` could build a developmental patched toolchain on this host. Every result below ran with that shim applied. The shim alone makes 15 baseline Quick tests fail: platform pins, adapter digests, inventories and doctor host checks.
